text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] == 'tcp') | ((df['swin'] == 0) & (df['dwin'] == 0) & (df['stcpb'] == 0) & (df['dtcpb'] == 0) & (df['tcprtt'] == 0) & (df['synack'] == 0) & (df['ackdat'] == 0))"],"features":["proto","swin","dwin","stcpb","dtcpb","tcprtt","synack","ackdat"],"rationale":"TCP window, sequence-number, and connection-setup fields are not applicable to non-TCP flows and are represented as zero."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'ftp') | (df['is_ftp_login'] == 0)"],"features":["service","is_ftp_login"],"rationale":"An FTP-login indicator cannot be set for a flow whose service is not FTP."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["df['service'].isin(['ftp', 'ftp-data']) | (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] == 0)","(df['service'] == 'ftp') | (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] == 0)"],"features":["service","ct_ftp_cmd"],"rationale":"FTP command counts apply to FTP sessions; the alternatives allow for whether FTP-data service labels are included in that scope."},{"id":"R4","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'http') | (df['ct_flw_http_mthd'] == 0)"],"features":["service","ct_flw_http_mthd"],"rationale":"The HTTP-method flow count must be zero when the service is not HTTP."},{"id":"R5","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'http') | ((df['trans_depth'] == 0) & (df['response_body_len'] == 0))"],"features":["service","trans_depth","response_body_len"],"rationale":"HTTP transaction depth and HTTP response-body length are inapplicable and represented as zero for non-HTTP services."}]}
